name: Venom Monsoon
doc: The Gila Grande's bullet heaven. VENOM MONSOON across the screen, the sand darkens round her, she rears up and her throat swells and glows purple; then for 14 s she sprays big, slow, wobbling venom blobs in a fan that sweeps left and right like a garden sprinkler, its middle always swinging across wherever you stand, and every second sweep adds a second, offset fan. The blobs leave little purple puddles where they fade (only a look). Her scales glow like armour: 80% less damage until it ends, then she collapses panting for 2.5 s taking 50% more. Not before 15 s into the fight; the first when she falls under 60% HP (or 45 s in at the latest); then 45 s after the last one is completely over (her panting seconds too).
